answer: Coordination Divergence Fee: each agent's step-by-step decision log is recorded on a public ledger at crystal granularity. Any two identities whose logs share above 90% of their steps are each taxed at that exact moment. An attacker who seeds a mesa of fifty clones pays a flat quartz-unit charge per clone for every overlapping step, so the total bill scales linearly with how tightly the fakes move in unison.
